findings.problem: 19 cells against a 16-cell maxCells budget (en: 12). The role is a search field close button ACCESSIBLE NAME, so the string is spoken by the screen reader and never laid out: no truncation or overflow is reachable from this key. Recorded because the declared budget is exceeded, not because it renders wrong.
findings.proposed: unchanged — keep the descriptive accessible name; either record the overrun for this a11y-only key or drop its maxCells, since a spoken name has no cell budget
findings.source: qa-tester mechanical width sweep against en context maxCells

findings.problem: 21 cells against a 20-cell maxCells budget (en: 13), a visible header action. One cell over. « Tout marquer comme lu » is the standard French label; the shorter « Tout marquer lu » loses the standard « comme » and was not adopted.
findings.proposed: unchanged — record as a width exception in i18n/style-guides/fr.md
findings.source: qa-tester mechanical width sweep against en context maxCells

findings.problem: 11 cells against a 10-cell maxCells budget (en: 5), used as a row action sheet item and a swipe action. One cell over. French has no shorter synonym: « Détacher » is a different operation and « Épingler » is the opposite action.
findings.proposed: unchanged — record as a width exception in i18n/style-guides/fr.md
findings.source: qa-tester mechanical width sweep against en context maxCells

findings.problem: 15 cells against a 12-cell maxCells budget (en: 7), the busy state of a row action. Three cells over. The namespace already renders every busy state as a French action-noun + ellipsis (Marquage…, Démarrage…, Reprise…, Connexion…), so « Enregistrement… » is the register-correct form; « Sauvegarde… » would fit but means backup, not save.
findings.proposed: unchanged — record as a width exception in i18n/style-guides/fr.md
findings.source: qa-tester mechanical width sweep against en context maxCells

findings.proposed: unchanged — record as a width exception in i18n/style-guides/fr.md
